dealCansHeading: Cans: any mix adding up to {count}
dealChoicesLeft: {count, plural, one {# choice} other {# choices}} left to add
dealChoosePops: Choose {count, plural, one {# pop} other {# pops}}
dealDrinkChoiceHint: The deal asks for one or the other. Switching clears the other side.
dealWingsHint: One flavour for all the wings
halfTileHint: Two pizzas on one pie, at the size price
ingredientsHint: Ingredients: tap to remove, no charge
menuConfirmFollows: Names, prices and which items are on sale follow the file.
menuConfirmMaster: The file is the master copy of the menu.
menuConfirmOverwrites: Changes made to these items in the product screen are overwritten.
menuConfirmSwitchedOff: Anything the file no longer has is switched off, not deleted.
menuFileHint: Choose the menu file. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
menuNotJson: {name} is not a menu file, so nothing was sent. A menu file is a JSON object. Fix the file and choose it again.
menuNotLoaded: The menu was not loaded. Check the connection to the POS and try again.
menuReadFailed: The loaded menu could not be read. Open this screen again to retry.
menuResult: Menu loaded: {created} added, {updated} changed, {unchanged} unchanged, {deactivated} switched off.
menuResultRows: These count entries in the POS catalogue, not menu items. Each category, product, size and add-on counts separately, and so do the records the POS keeps about the menu. So removing one pizza with three sizes shows as 4 switched off, plus a few changed, because the stored menu and the place of other items change with it.
menuUntaxed: The store does not have both the "food" and "soda" tax categories, so items were loaded without a tax category of their own. Once the store has them, load the file again.
notOnPos: This pizza is not on sale in the POS. Load the menu file again.
quickDeleteBody: The button is removed from this screen. Orders already placed are not changed.
quickFailed: The button was not changed. Check the connection to the POS and try again.
quickNoCustomer: The order has no customer now. Choose who the button is for again.
quickNone: No quick buttons yet. Save one from a line of the order or from the pizza sheet.
quickNotOnPos: This item is not on sale in the POS right now.
quickOrderEmpty: Add the item to the order first, then save it.
quickSaveFromOrder: Save an item from the order for {name}
quickShopHint: Tap a button to add it · ⋯ to edit or delete
sentAddFromPos: Add a half and half or a deal from the POS
sentPriceReset: This line has its own price or a discount. Saving a change returns it to the menu price.
setupProfileDesc: Counter service for a pizza shop in British Columbia.
setupProfileDetails: Sets Canada, Canadian dollars, Vancouver time, and GST and PST. Seeds no menu. Go back to the first step to change the currency or time zone.
setupProfileNeedsCanada: The pizza shop profile sets up British Columbia tax. Choose Canada in the first step, or pick another option here.
smallItemsHint: Tap a tile to add one. It goes straight into the order.
